title: Kenyan Tropical Pavlova
community: Urban Kenya — the spectacular showpiece dessert
author: Chef Amina Hassan
desc: Kenyan Tropical Pavlova — a large crispy meringue with a marshmallowy centre, topped with whipped coconut cream, passion fruit curd, and a stunning mosaic of tropical fruit. The most spectacular dessert in Kenya's hotel repertoire — and the one most photographed.
longDesc: The tropical pavlova is the hotel restaurant dessert that creates the most excitement — the enormous crispy meringue dome, crowned with whipped cream and glistening with fresh tropical fruit, arrives at the table and stops conversation. Kenya's fruits make this version incomparably better than any other.
steps: Preheat oven to 120°C. Draw a 24cm circle on parchment. Flip parchment over.
Whisk egg whites to stiff peaks. Gradually add sugar one tablespoon at a time, whisking until glossy and thick — 10—12 minutes.
Fold in vinegar, cornstarch, and vanilla.
Spoon onto circle. Create a slight indentation in the centre and taller edges.
Bake 90 minutes until crispy outside and dry. Turn oven off. Leave to cool inside oven — minimum 2 hours.
Whip coconut cream with icing sugar to soft peaks.
Top pavlova with coconut cream, passion fruit curd, and arranged tropical fruit.
Serve immediately — pavlova softens when refrigerated.
chefTips: Egg whites must be at room temperature — cold whites do not whip to maximum volume.
Add sugar one tablespoon at a time — adding too quickly produces a grainy, unstable meringue.
The low-temperature bake and in-oven cool is what creates the chewy marshmallow centre with crispy shell.
commonMistakes: Opening the oven during cooling — it collapses.
cookingScience: The vinegar and cornstarch are the scientific secrets of pavlova. Vinegar slightly denatures the egg white proteins, creating a more stable foam. Cornstarch prevents excessive moisture release during baking (a common meringue problem), helping the interior stay chewy and marshmallowy.
sustainabilityTips: The meringue uses egg whites — a zero-waste approach to leftover egg whites.
storage: Make the meringue base 1 day ahead — store at room temperature uncovered. Top only at service.
culturalNote: The tropical pavlova is one of Kenya's most spectacular desserts — a white mountain of meringue crowned with the country's most vibrant fruits. It is simultaneously a feat of technique and a celebration of Kenyan agricultural abundance.
